summary: No favicon, app icon or og:image: /favicon.ico answered 404 on every page (a console error in Lighthouse) and a shared link had no picture.
fix: The approved “J” mark and the “Time with Jon” share image as App Router files (favicon.ico, icon.svg, apple-icon.png, opengraph-image.png + alt); the layout's metadataBase is the site's own origin (getSiteUrl, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL alone) so og:image is absolute.
